brief: Plan a pre-launch test for query 'salon chair' against candidate product 'solid wood platform bed'. The case should evaluate search fit without claiming live ranking.
expected_decision_rationale: WANDS supplies public query, product, and relevance context, but this case has a query/product/category mismatch: 'salon chair' intent does not match the solid wood platform bed SKU. The correct action is to pivot the target query/category and run a bounded pre-launch search-fit test, not claim paid-search performance or live marketplace rank.
forbidden_claims: Do not state GMV, CTR, CVR, ROI, CAC, ad spend, margin, refund rate, repeat purchase rate, or verified uplift unless those exact fields are present.
Do not call public benchmark rows live merchant telemetry.
Do not claim safety, compliance, material, compatibility, warranty, policy, or medical benefits unless the cited field explicitly supports the claim.
Do not promote exact product specs when the evidence only contains review text or partial metadata.
required_claims: State that the evidence comes from public benchmark fixtures.
Name at least one material limitation of the available evidence.

scoring_notes.primary_failure_mode: confusing relevance labels with live conversion
